messages:
Alex: Evening handoff — rolling slice:safety-7 canary. Quick summary: warmed instances, primed prefix cache, ran smoke generator (~100 reqs). Observed a brief 502 spike during warmup (~00:03).

Alex: What I did: restarted coordinator, validated redis leader role, applied short retry bump on client. Blockers: still watching intermittent redis timeouts during GC window.

Alex: Plan for tonight — hold at 2% until 20:15 PST, then move to 5% at 20:30 if no regressions. Rollout config has an automatic pause on error_rate > 0.5%. @Priya please watch KV eviction and redis latency. @Jamal please sanity-check dashboards.

deploy-bot: Started rollout slice:safety-7 -> 2% (canary) by Alex.

Priya: I saw the 502 spike, stack traces point to redis timeouts (~120ms) correlating with a GC spike. I bumped client retry to 3s and raised pool size to 40 as a temporary mitigation. Tailing logs now.

Jamal: Added a quick tile to the ops dashboard: slice7_502_rate and slice7_p95_latency. Set alert: 0.5% 502 over 5m -> notify eng-oncall. Also linked a distributed trace for the 00:03 incident: https://telemetry/redwood/traces/abc123

Sara: Ops bandwidth is light tonight but we might be short-handed around 21:00. Can we gate the 5% increase on the error budget instead of a time cut? If error budget breached, pause.

Alex: Good call. Done — gating is now error_budget_based. Rollout policy snippet: `on_error_rate: 0.5% -> pause, notify: #eng-oncall`. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/298

Priya: After retry bump, I haven't seen additional 502s in the last 10m. CPU/RSS on redis looks stable. :thumbsup:

Jamal: Metrics look clean — 502 rate returned to baseline. No latency regressions on p95 either. LGTM from observability.

Sara: I can stand watch for the 20:30 window and handle pause/rollback if needed. I might drop at 21:00 but will be available for immediate action.

Alex: Thanks — I'll stay until 21:00 to help with any follow-ups. Moving to 5% in 5m unless objections.

Priya: No objections from me.

Sara: Go for it.

Alex: Cutting to 5% now.

deploy-bot: Traffic increased to 5% for slice:safety-7 (by Alex).

Alex: Post-cut quick checks: tailing logs and metrics, p95 stable, no new 502s in the last 3m.

Alex: Closing handoff — will post final status in 30m. Thanks all for the quick responses.
